prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory decision support for WUI wildfire detection/suppression. Elements: Caldera Incident Command Portal (alias Emberhall): primary interface for Duty Detection Officer, County Emergency Liaison, command staff; shows cameras, history, weather, maps, states; opens triage case when automated confidence exceeds screening threshold; records reason for each triage decision (advanced/held/dismissed); can set Airspace Restricted State before aircraft tasking. North and South Lookout Camera Masts: hardened power, lightning protection, licensed wireless video, cellular degraded path; North sends Thermal Spot Snippet. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (alias Kestrel): produces Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Tasking Service: flight requests, constraints, task status; not flight-release authority; may prepare Kestrel verification task when fixed view blocked; Drone Pilot Operator confirms task safe and within constraints. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (alias Lantern): normalizes image/thermal/weather into common event record; traceable recommendations; retains timing, source IDs, model versions, acknowledgments; score not a fire declaration. Smoke Classifier Module: sends plume confidence to Lantern; produces Ridge Shadow Mask. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (alias Brindle): weather QC/context; sends Wind Shift Bulletin. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater: recorded, access-controlled voice coordination for independent field/aviation confirmation. Crewline Mobile Tablet: Helitack Crew Leader receives only confirmed context released for field distribution. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (alias Marigold; record uses full name): for Air Attack Supervisor, Tanker Base Manager. East and West Retardant Loading Pumps: East sends Retardant Batch Slip after load metered and sealed. Baseline: segmentation, time sync, health checks, audit logging. Actors: County Emergency Liaison; Duty Detection Officer (alias Orion) reviews triage, records restriction basis in portal; Air Attack Supervisor (alias Redtail; record uses full name) confirms operating window; Tanker Base Manager; Helitack Crew Leader; Drone Pilot Operator. States: suspected ignition (stays in triage if evidence inconsistent, stale, or single low-confidence source); Confirmed Ignition State requires persistent smoke or thermal cue plus independent sensor, field report, or recorded authorized human visual judgment; includes location, confidence basis, history, reviewer identity, coordination posture; enables suppression planning. Airspace Restricted State: aircraft tasking conditional until Air Attack Supervisor confirms window. Dismissed cases searchable for audit/model

New part:
S079: The Air Attack Supervisor is responsible for deconflicting fixed-wing, rotary-wing, and uncrewed routes before the Drone Pilot Operator launches from the Horizon Ridge Drone Dock.
S080: The Drone Tasking Service shall not issue a launch task that conflicts with an active aviation lane maintained by the Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console.
S081: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console provides the aviation status view used by the Tanker Base Manager to sequence retardant aircraft availability.
S082: The Tanker Base Manager coordinates pump readiness for the East Retardant Loading Pump and the West Retardant Loading Pump before confirming that a tanker can accept an assignment.
S083: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater is also known as Badger for voice traffic when a short call sign is needed during congested incident radio operations.
S084: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater bridges command, air-to-ground, and county liaison talk paths when direct radio coverage is degraded by terrain.
S085: Radio bridging shall preserve the original speaker identity when the source channel provides it, because aviation supervisors use that identity to validate tasking and hazard reports.
S086: If a bridge path fails, the Caldera Incident Command Portal marks the affected radio route as impaired and requires manual acknowledgement by the Duty Detection Officer.
S087: Orion must verify that the impaired route has an alternate contact method before any new aviation coordination message is accepted.
S088: The County Emergency Liaison is the primary contact for county dispatch, road control, evacuation support, and local public safety notifications.
S089: The County Emergency Liaison sends the Drone Corridor Permit after local jurisdiction review is complete.
S090: County liaison procedures require that jurisdictional constraints be entered in the Caldera Incident Command Portal before the Drone Pilot Operator receives a route briefing.
S091: Temporary flight restrictions are requested through the established incident aviation chain and are represented internally by the Airspace Restricted State only after acceptance by the responsible authority.
S092: The Air Attack Supervisor reviews each temporary restriction against current fire perimeter intelligence from the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine before approving a release of air assets.
S093: The MesoWest Weather Fusion Node supplies wind and visibility context used by aviation supervisors during route selection and holding-area planning.
S094: The North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast provide observation context that helps the Air Attack Supervisor assess whether smoke columns may reduce route visibility.
S095: The South Lookout Camera Mast produces the Camera Cleaning Log as part of its maintenance reporting.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
